name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO, 20V — SOT
description: Cluster of 7 surface-mount 20V LDO linear regulator ICs using SOT footprints including SOT-223-3, SOT-223-3_TabPin2, and SOT-89-3.
selection_hints: Choose based on footprint requirements like SOT-223-3, SOT-223-3_TabPin2, or SOT-89-3.
Prefer Tier A representative parts such as AZ1117H-ADJ or AZ1117R-ADJ.
Select between fixed voltage outputs and adjustable variants.
avoid_when: Through-hole assembly is required instead of SMD mounting.
The PCB layout requires package footprints outside the SOT family.
The circuit requires a non-LDO or switching regulator.
